027de5271d4a4ff09fe8039b85ebb7eeb09c1322.caption: A breadcrumb component in an expanded state with a simple hierarchical structure. It includes an icon leading the label "Home," followed by text labels "Level 2" and "Current," separated by slashes. The text explains that icons are permitted when paired with a label, must be placed before the label, and should only be used in simple hierarchical structures to avoid taking up too much space.

04f65488cc7e4dbad80c3d9970f9a659eb7d947b.caption: A breadcrumb component with a truncation button variant, showing how it handles truncation when there are many levels. The truncation button is a small ghost button with adjusted paddings to match the links and avoid layout shifts. Callout 1 points to the truncation button in a hover state, and callout 2 points to the truncation button in a focus state. The breadcrumb levels shown are "Home", "...", "Previous level", and "Current".

28358276403e51d3681afb3207adf68f3314ecea.caption: Two breadcrumb components. The first breadcrumb is at level 2, showing "Home / Level 2 / Previous level / Current" with all levels visible. The second breadcrumb is at level 6 and above, showing "Home / ... / Previous level / Current" with only the first and last two levels visible, and intermediate levels replaced by an ellipsis.

310a782ad561c78f9003d2cf467af1860bcc2dd3.caption: A breadcrumb component in an expanded state. It shows a sequence of links labeled "Home", "Sustainability", and "Environmental protection", separated by slashes. The ideal length for each link label is specified as 1 or 2 words, with a maximum of 2-3 words. The last link, "Environmental protection", is underlined, indicating it is the current page.

40992acf546dc4990b0981b83b34cc3a15e2fb88.caption: A breadcrumb component in a complex navigation structure with six levels, shown in both desktop and mobile viewports. The breadcrumb levels are expanded, and the title component is labeled "Title Component" with size xl. The text "Cashback sichern mit dem Code “Cashback2024”" is present in both views, along with navigation items such as "Produkte," "Ratgeber und Projekte," "Services und Events," and "Lösungen für Profis." The breadcrumb levels include "Startseite," "Gartenpflege," "Heckenpflege," "Buchsbaum-Formschnitt," and "Wie Sie einen Buchsbaum zur Spirale schneiden.

595f6c8f55c93e44067e30dd545622536039af0a.caption: A breadcrumb component in a simple navigation layout. The breadcrumb trail includes the labels "Home", "Saw chain finder", and "Search results", with "Search results" highlighted to indicate the current page. The text next to the figure explains that in shallow navigation structures, a breadcrumb might be optional but can still improve navigation efficiency and provide context.

9843ebac9cd5036d084b92c876f3b95cc498a996.caption: A breadcrumb component with two states: expanded and collapsed. In the expanded state, all navigation levels from "Home" to "Current" are visible, separated by slashes. In the collapsed state, intermediate levels are hidden behind a truncation button labeled with an ellipsis (...), showing only "Home", "Previous level", and "Current". The "home" link is always visible, as is the "current-page" link labeled "Current", which is in an active state. The "previous-page" link labeled "Previous level" is also always visible. The breadcrumb is designed to provide orientation within a website or application, with the layout always left-aligned and superior to the page title and content.

a9d5a306ae8e5b207334301735c85f0d41e8967b.caption: A breadcrumb component at level 6, shown in an expanded state. The breadcrumb includes the following text elements: "Home", "/", "About STIHL", "International production and distribution", and "STIHL in Brazil". The text next to the figure warns that using full page titles as link labels in breadcrumbs can make them hard to comprehend.

af356f79bf1f22782162ec35d96f2ddb9485c4de.caption: Two variants of the breadcrumb component, illustrating different states and layouts. The first breadcrumb shows a truncated list with a truncation button, while the second breadcrumb shows an expanded list of all levels. Callout 1 points to a standalone link labeled "Home," callout 2 points to the truncation button labeled "...", callout 3 points to a standalone link labeled "Previous level," and callout 4 points to the active standalone link labeled "Current." The breadcrumb components include dividers represented by "/", and various levels labeled "Level 2," "Level 3," "Level 4," "Level 5," and "Level 6.

bcefafe042cdc173a6205c2479b4a4e9b058540e.caption: A breadcrumb component in its initial state on a bigger screen, ideally fitting within one line. The breadcrumb includes six levels of navigation, with the title "Title Component" shown in a large size. The text "Example with >5 levels" indicates that the breadcrumb can handle more than five levels...

d105bad3443e5537e5e12b8e1ce83edc521e9322.caption: A breadcrumb component with center alignment. This is marked as a "Don't" example because centering a breadcrumb is uncommon and does not align with the typical mental model of a breadcrumb. The text "/ " is shown to represent the breadcrumb items.

dc1e70526b0f7c04b62f99c6070a853a90d79d76.caption: A breadcrumb component in an expanded state with three items: "The STIHL World", "Sustainability", and "Environmental protection". The example is marked as a "Don't" because it uses marketing language "The STIHL World" instead of "Home". The design documentation advises against using marketing language in the breadcrumb.

e120073e73452c40a007e1ba7383e255bd54164a.caption: A breadcrumb component with left alignment. The breadcrumb is positioned in the top left corner, below an implied main navigation, and above the page title and content. This layout is marked as a "Do" example because it follows the guideline of left alignment to reduce cognitive load, assuming a left-to-right reading direction.

eba65bdb9cc3b8c3ee45a7decfed19d7776f1fe8.caption: Two variants of the breadcrumb component in the STIHL Design System. The first example shows a breadcrumb with more than five levels, including "Startseite", "...", "Gartenpflege", and "Rasenpflege", demonstrating a state where the breadcrumb navigation exceeds two lines. The second example shows a breadcrumb with four levels, including "Startseite", "STIHL Technologie", "STIHL Akku-Technologie", and "STIHL Akku AP-System", illustrating a state where the breadcrumb navigation is expanded. The text indicates that ideally, the breadcrumb navigation should not exceed two lines, three lines are allowed, but four lines should be avoided.

ed1853ce4952db7b70523b7ed5a3c61eb1ae2136.caption: A breadcrumb component with two states: truncated and expanded. Callout 1 points to the truncated state where links are hidden behind a button labeled with three dots "...", and callout 2 points to the expanded state where all links are shown. The breadcrumb shows levels labeled "Home", "Level 2", "Level 3", "Level 4", "Level 5", "Level 6", "Previous level", and "Current", with the expanded state revealing all levels on click.

fd10c215d795e6149f168eb2f5d8344c25c6903c.caption: A breadcrumb component with levels labeled "Home", "Chainsaws", and "MS 211", with an ellipsis indicating additional hidden links. The cursor is shown as a pointer over the ellipsis, triggering a browser default tooltip that says "Show all links". The tooltip explains the action to the user and is also accessible via screenreader. The breadcrumb is in a collapsed state with expanded set to false.
